'''2007 Illinois State Championship Brian Fred LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I'm gonna "Lunge" on you like a spider monkey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
